create_media_container.description: Upload media and create media containers. Threads processes the container before it can be published: the step returns processing accepted and the container ID; read its status with Get media container status and publish it with Publish media container. A TEXT container with auto_publish_text true is published by Threads without the publish step: then processing is completed, applied true and no check. Needs threads_basic, threads_content_publish.

Setting `is_made_with_ai=true` on an individual carousel item (`is_carousel_item=true`) returns an error. Omitting this parameter or setting it to `false` does not add an AI self-disclosure. It does not prevent automatic AI labeling. See Label AI-generated content for an example.
